biggest_catch: Applying never guarantees contact — founders choose who to engage, and YC roles are competitive.
catches: No payment handled by the board — offers and pay are negotiated with each startup.
YC startup jobs are competitive; a profile does not guarantee any founder contact.
Many roles are salaried employment with interviews, not instant gigs.
Listings can be US-centric or batch-specific; filter by your eligibility.

c1.evidence: The official Y Combinator jobs board (ycombinator.com/jobs) states: 'Apply to thousands of startup jobs with a single profile. Let YC founders contact you or browse companies privately.' — a real, live, provider-owned deal channel for startup roles.

c2.evidence: Official pages publish no fixed pay range — compensation is set per startup/offer; framed as variable.

c3.evidence: Steps follow the board flow: create a single profile, browse YC companies, apply or let founders contact you.

c4.evidence: No fee appears on official pages for job seekers creating a profile or applying.

eligibility: Anyone who can build a profile and meet the requirements of listed startup roles.
notes: Scenario: startup job board. Y Combinator's official jobs board lets candidates apply to thousands of YC startup roles with one profile and lets founders contact candidates directly. Distinct from the Hacker News monthly freelancer thread (R2026) — this is YC's company jobs platform with profiles and direct applications. Pay is per offer and negotiated — variable.
numeric_basis: payout: compensation is set per startup and role; the board publishes no pay ranges. time: build profile + browse + apply to matching roles, est. 30-90 min active.
payout_quote: Apply to thousands of startup jobs with a single profile.
payout_value_note: The board publishes no pay ranges — compensation is set per startup and negotiated per offer; variable.

s1.note: Eligibility: anyone able to build a profile and meet listed role requirements.

steps: Create a single candidate profile on the YC jobs board.
Browse YC companies and open roles privately, or let YC founders contact you.
Apply to matching roles through the board.
Complete each startup's interview process and negotiate the offer directly.
timing: Listings post continuously; hiring timelines follow each startup.
